target_customer: Developers building AI agents and apps that need many third party integrations
problem: Connecting agents to many third party APIs means maintaining each integration, auth and permissions.
business_model: Open source core (Apache-2.0 per aggregator) with hosted hub and pay-per-call pricing for some tools

founders.name: Dev Jain
education: University of Texas at Austin, mechanical engineering and economics (per YC page)
previous_startups: Demeter, an AI back office for private investors (per yespress.io listing, unverified)
founders.background_notes: YC page labels him CTO while his bio says CEO

technical_complexity.rationale: A typed plugin framework plus MCP hosting is standard engineering; breadth of maintained integrations is laborious.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and easily forked; value rests on integration coverage and community.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several integration platforms added agent tooling during 2025 per vendor comparisons; no acquisition of Corsair found.

market_need_then: Demand for agent tool access grew with MCP in 2025; dated sources for the batch period were not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses corsair.dev; the Corsair hardware brand dominates the .com
branding.community_and_virality: Aggregator reports about 6.6k GitHub stars; not verified.

brand_strength.rationale: Name shared with a large PC hardware brand, hurting search; open source repo gives some developer awareness.

outcome_analysis: Corsair is an active Winter 2025 company with a two person team, backed by YC, with no verified raise. No shutdown or acquisition was found. It competes in a crowded integration tooling market with well funded vendors, so its outcome is undetermined and depends on open source adoption.
notes: Funding unverified: one aggregator lists 500K pre-seed March 2025 from YC. No dated competitor source near batch (Jan to Mar 2025) was found; vendor comparison pages are dated 2026, so the list is empty. Aggregator star and integration counts unverified. Update: the 500K pre-seed of March 2025 is recorded from a single aggregator listing found under the name Demeter (origami.chat); that Demeter is the same company is likely but not confirmed. Another profile says only a seed during W25 with no amount.
